lines.text: The hum has not stopped. Every stone knows the note. Find the rig.
The yard waits. Eleven minutes is a long time to wait for the answer.
The yard took the second and third pier. You took what you could. It stands, and nobody sings about it. Adequate.
The Span holds under Dominion bracing. It will need its own by winter. We will do that.
You held it alone. We arrived late. I am sorry. I am also angry. Both.
